parent_objective: design pair-expanded calibrated history interventions after M1550 pair gate pass
blocked_by: pair-expanded interventions have not yet been designed
supersedes: direct implementation of pair-expanded interventions without audit caveats

public_gates: M1552 must design interventions over M1550 accepted pairs
M1552 must preserve source-edge and endpoint-reuse diagnostics
M1552 must include reset zero-current zero-action delayed wrong-history donor-hidden and donor-response variants
M1552 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M1552 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs bounded pair-expanded calibrated history interventions after M1550 pair coverage pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation smoke, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design ignores M1550 snapshot-count caveat
stop if design routes directly to training or materialization
stop if design weakens history-positive thresholds
stop if design changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: route to implementation only if endpoint reuse, edge diversity, replay, and control gates are explicit
route to snapshot-window repair if intervention design cannot handle the M1550 snapshot caveat
stop the branch if pair-expanded interventions are null or control-dominated
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1551 admits a bounded pair-expanded intervention design

admission_evidence: M1551 audited M1550 as pair-gate pass with snapshot-count caveat
allowed_updates: M1552 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if the design admits it
next_stage_criteria: intervention variants and accepted-pair filters are explicit
endpoint reuse and source-edge diagnostics are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1552 is a design milestone and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: planned donor response/action plus hidden interventions
planned reset zero-current zero-action and delayed controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: future pair-expanded calibrated intervention smoke only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If pair-expanded interventions are null or control-dominated, record it and audit before any materialization.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded intervention design over the M1550 accepted pairs can test whether pair-expanded terminal-boundary rows produce history-sensitive effects while preserving all no-training guardrails.
success_criteria: design specifies intervention variants and accepted-pair filters
design specifies endpoint reuse, edge diversity, replay, history, and control gates
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
design changes actor inputs or weakens history-positive standards
decision_rule: M1552 passes if it defines a no-training pair-expanded intervention plan with explicit diversity and history/control gates.
